content_of_post_to_answer: What is one healthy habit that completely changed your life?
answer: The habit that changed my life was learning to protect my attention. I used to think improvement came from adding more routines, but I realized the bigger shift was removing the constant distractions that kept me reacting instead of choosing. I've written more about this pattern on my profile for anyone who wants to explore it further. A healthy life is often built less by what we force ourselves to do and more by what we stop allowing to consume us.
